text:
mike: opened a tiny follow-up to the OptKit docs to add an end-to-end micro-batching + KV-prefetch + quant guidance snippet. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5180
anya: sweet. can we include both Python and TS snippets and keep each under 12 lines for the sidebar?
felix: also please avoid a hard recommend for a single quant. suggest: "recommend q3_k for short-chat (seq<64); q2_x or q4_0 for extreme mem/perf tradeoffs". add a one-sentence rationale.
mike: updated PR to include Python + TypeScript, trimmed to 10 lines each, and changed wording to advisory + rationale.
ci-bot: docs-lint: warning: missing-anchor `kv-prefetch` in docs/optkit/migrate.md; older builds may 404.
anya: link to canonical reference `/docs/sdk/reference/kv-prefetch` and add `(redirects from /legacy/kv)` to help bookmarks.
mike: done. added the redirect note and a one-line CLI smoke command: `redwood-opt run --profile q3_k --batch 6 --kv-prefetch`.
docs-bot: preview-build: success — https://deploy-preview-5180--docs.redwood.ai
felix: wording tweak: change "use batching to save cost" -> "use micro-batching to reduce per-token cost while monitoring tail latency"
mike: updated and merged after CI green. will watch the feedback thread for confusion around q2_x vs q3_k. thanks!
